rules: docs/correlation-and-risk-design.md with the team answers of 28 Oct 2026 (Q1-Q9) and the proposed defaults of Q10-Q16: 15-minute inclusive gap window, escalated to 30 minutes while a key value's chain has reached kill-chain stage 2 or later (adaptive memory, ends when the chain breaks), keys host / unordered ip_pair / user, context never merges groups and uses the 15-minute window only, nearest-in-time context with ties to the earliest group, incident of one event. Incident type = attack type of the most advanced kill-chain stage (Q9), stages from backend/app/correlation/correlation.toml (provisional: Reconnaissance/Analysis/Fuzzers 1, Generic/Exploits 2, Shellcode/Backdoors 3, Worms 4, DoS 5).

incidents.label: A
incidents.case: Multi-step attack: Reconnaissance -> Exploits -> Backdoors over web-01, db-01 and file-01, chained through host, ip_pair and user

incidents.label: F
incidents.case: Flagged event with no host, IP or user: it can never link, so it is an incident of one event

incidents.label: C1
incidents.case: Ambiguous case, first group: fuzzing on ws-41. Gets context fx-023, which is 9.5 min from both groups (tie -> earliest group)

incidents.label: C2
incidents.case: Ambiguous case, second group: DoS on ws-42 by admin-shared. Gets context fx-024 (8 min away, nearer than C1 at 11 min). The shared context events do not merge C1 and C2

incidents.label: D1
incidents.case: Window boundary: two flagged events on ws-50 exactly 15:00 apart are linked (inclusive boundary, Q1)

incidents.label: D2a
incidents.case: Window boundary: first of two flagged events on ws-51 that are 15:01 apart, so not linked

incidents.label: D2b
incidents.case: Window boundary: second flagged event on ws-51, 1 second past the window

incidents.label: E
incidents.case: Isolated flagged event without an attack type: incident of one event, incident_type null

incidents.label: G1
incidents.case: Adaptive memory: Exploits on ws-80 (stage 2) extends the window for host ws-80 to 30 min, so the Backdoors event 20 min later joins

incidents.label: G2a
incidents.case: Adaptive memory control: two scans on ws-81 20 min apart. Reconnaissance is stage 1, so the window stays 15 min and they are not linked

incidents.label: G2b
incidents.case: Adaptive memory control: second scan on ws-81

incidents.label: G3
incidents.case: Memory expiry: scan on ws-80 40 min after G1 (beyond the 30 min escalated window), so the chain breaks and the memory ends

incidents.label: G4
incidents.case: Memory expiry: scan on ws-80 20 min after G3. The memory ended, so the window is 15 min again and it is not linked
